# TildaZ v0.10.1

**The search and copy shortcuts are named `find` and `copy` in the config, matching the menu.**

- `[keys]` renames two actions: `open_search` → `find` and `copy_selection` → `copy`. The
  menu already said `Find` and `Copy`, so looking up either in the config found nothing.
  ([#666](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/666))

## Upgrade notes

- A config written by v0.10.0 keeps working. On the next start TildaZ uses the default
  binding for `find` and `copy`, and the startup notice lists the two new names to add and
  the two old ones to delete. Rename them in place to keep your own bindings:

  ```toml
  find = ["cmd+f"]          # was open_search
  copy = ["cmd+c"]          # was copy_selection
  ```

  A config from v0.9.x or earlier never had `open_search`, so only `copy_selection` needs
  the rename there.
